hero.title: AI receptionist for clinics – more time for your patients
hero.subtitle: As a clinic, you know how important it is to give your patients the best possible treatment. But administrative tasks like phone calls, bookings, and cancellations steal valuable time away from patient care.

solution.title: The complete solution for healthcare
solution.description: Our AI receptionist handles every customer enquiry professionally – from new bookings to rebookings and confirmations. Patients can move or cancel their appointment around the clock, so the slot can go to someone else. Your dashboard gives you the overview: listen to every call and see short summaries of each conversation and what was agreed. Bookings go straight into Google Calendar, Outlook/Microsoft 365 or Cal.com.
